Any objections? <@741547166656626700> , since when you have eth/69 implemented? If that feels wrong, happy to correct. > We could: > > 1. agree to activate v4+v5 by default on all devnets v4+v5 is already going on mainnet for most clients. Why not do v5 only on devnets? > 2. track activation on testnets By activation do you mean activation on fork boundary? I don't think we have to do the actual behavior change on fork boundary. Or do you mean just general transition risk? > 3. discuss it during ACDTs I had to skip the last one, but we can > Periodic call might be cool Sorry, I had to delay this a bit. I will set it up for a date after EthBoulder/EthDenver. eth/69 is implemented since erigon v3.2.0 (kudos to <@253514520142544899>) I see your Fusaka release was v3.3.0, so that was before. Good! Is there any client that **did not have** eth/69 in their Fusaka release?

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content:
We are planning to deprecate eth/68 soonish. We are not seeing it used in nodes we run, eth/69 had been out for quite some time, and we are moving on to eth/70 soon. Any objections?
<@741547166656626700> , since when you have eth/69 implemented?

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content:
Commitment is not even a question, right? 🙂

That's why I'm using it as a status tracker, planning to update towards off with release number ween it happens. If that feels wrong, happy to correct.

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content:
> We could: 
> > 1. agree to activate v4+v5 by default on all devnets
v4+v5 is already going on mainnet for most clients. Why not do v5 only on devnets?

> 2. track activation on testnets
By activation do you mean activation on fork boundary? I don't think we have to do the actual behavior change on fork boundary. Or do you mean just general transition risk?  

> 3. discuss it during ACDTs
I had to skip the last one, but we can

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content:
> Periodic call might be cool

Sorry, I had to delay this a bit. I will set it up for a date after EthBoulder/EthDenver.
